(a) HOLDS(需加分母限定)。逐字:「We recruited 19,857 Facebook users and 15,585 Instagram users who spent at least 15 minutes per day on the respective platform.」描述统计节复核漏斗:FB 1060 万邀请→673,388 点击→43,249 完成入组问卷→19,857 进入 primary analysis sample;IG 260 万邀请→319,271 点击→42,658 入组→15,585。论文自陈「less than one percent of the people who were invited to the study completed the experiment underscores that one should be cautious in generalizing results outside our sample.」

(b) 数值与显著性 HOLDS。逐字:「Facebook and Instagram deactivation improved emotional state index by 0.060 standard deviations (p < 0.001) and 0.041 standard deviations (p = 0.016), respectively.」FB 校正后 q=0.002,确实仍显著。三个分项 FB:happy +0.064(p<0.001)、depressed×(-1) +0.039(p=0.018)、anxious×(-1) +0.028(p=0.110)。

(e) HOLDS(需分平台)。逐字:「app use data show that when people deactivate, most of time freed by Facebook deactivation and all of time freed by Instagram deactivation is substituted to other smartphone apps.」机制推论逐字:「this suggests that the effects are mostly driven by the different user experiences of Facebook or Instagram compared to other apps.」替代去向包括 Twitter、Snapchat、TikTok、YouTube、网页浏览;FB 停用还使 IG 使用增加 4 分钟/天,反向不显著。

(f) HOLDS,设计细节完全坐实。逐字:「The Deactivation group was told that they would receive $150 if they did not log into the focal platform for the next six weeks, while the Control group was told that they would receive $25 if they did not log in for the next week.」时间线:9/23 统一停用;对照组 9/30 自动恢复、处理组 11/4 恢复。设计动机逐字:「By including a short deactivation period for the Control group, we guaranteed that the only differences between Control and Deactivation were the total payment amount and deactivation length... (b) 统计量性质:0.060 与 0.041 不是 ITT(意向治疗)差值,而是 IV/LATE。论文 equation (1) 用 Deactivation 组指示变量 Ti 工具化“停用依从度”Di,并加 lasso 选出的控制变量与代表性权重。原文:“τ measures the local average treatment effect of never using the platform instead of using the Control group average, for people induced to deactivate by the $150 payment.” 一阶段系数 FB 0.871 / IG 0.893。修正前“+0.060 SD 效应”→ 修正后“+0.060 SD 的 LATE(完全不用 vs 用到对照组均值),对应 ITT 约为其 0.87 倍”。

(b) 时间窗:实验组停用 6 周,但对照组也停用第 1 周,依从度测量窗口是 9/30–11/3,即两组真正的差异期为 5 周。论文在跨研究比较中自述“the longest abstention period (5 weeks, compared to a prior maximum of 4 weeks)”。修正前“停用 6 周的效应”→ 修正后“6 周 vs 1 周的对比,净差异暴露为 5 周”。

(d) 年龄分组口径(最关键修正):“35 岁以上”与“25 岁以下”不是同一把尺子上的年龄梯度,而是各自样本内的中位数切分,因两个样本年龄分布不同而落在不同岁数。原文:“The age survey question had coarse response categories; we allocate the median category to the above-median group. This yields 18-34 vs. 35+ and 18-24 vs. 25+ as the age groups in the Facebook and Instagram samples, respectively”。修正前“FB 效应由 35 岁以上驱动、IG 由 25 岁以下女性驱动(暗示年龄梯度)”→ 修正后“FB 样本按中位数切成 18-34 vs 35+,IG 样本切成 18-24 vs 25+;阈值差异是样本中位数的产物,不构成跨平台可比的年龄梯度证据”。另“over 35”严格说是“35+”(含 35 岁)。

(d) 子群显著性:Instagram 的“年轻女性驱动”所依赖的四个年龄×性别子群差异检验 p = 0.062,未达 0.05;Facebook 的 35+ vs 18-34 差异 p = 0.046。二者均为未预注册的探索性分析且报告的是未校正 p 值(论文明示“We present unadjusted p-values for subgroup analyses”)。修正前“效应由 35 岁以上驱动 / 由 25 岁以下女性驱动”→ 修正后“点估计更大,FB 组间差异 p=0.046、IG 组间差异 p=0.062(未校正、未预注册);IG 的组间异质性未达 0.05”。

(e) 时间替代:需按平台分别陈述,不能合并成一句。Instagram:停用对手机总使用时长无显著影响,即“all of the time participants would have spent on Instagram was substituted to other apps”。Facebook:总 app 时长下降约 9 分钟/天,焦点平台下降 37 分钟/天,“around three-quarters of the reduction in Facebook use from deactivation was substituted to other apps”。修正前“释放时间大部分流向其他手机 app”→ 修正后“IG 几乎全部流向其他 app(无线下回流);FB 约四分之三流向其他 app,另有约 9 分钟/天转为线下”。

(c) 0.14 的统计量单位:论文正文报告的是多重检验校正后的 q-value = 0.139(FB 为 0.002),导论段落则表述为“at the p = 0.14 level after adjusting for multiple hypothesis testing”。修正前“校正后 p=0.14”→ 修正后“校正后 q = 0.139(论文导论亦写作 p = 0.14),校正对象是本文情绪结果 + Allcott et al. (2024) 全套政治结果”。
evidence_notes: 一手来源已取得并全文文本化:https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w33697/w33697.pdf(NBER WP 33697,2025 年 4 月)。NBER 论文页 https://www.nber.org/papers/w33697 显示无修订版本(Revision Date: none)、截至 2026-07-27 无期刊发表版,故不存在后续勘误可核。

(a) 逐字:“Of these, 19,857 completed the baseline survey, could be linked to platform data, and had at least 15 minutes of baseline use per day. This final group is our ‘primary analysis sample.’ On Instagram, the analogous numbers are 2.6 million invites, 319,271 clicks, 42,658 enrollment survey completes, and 15,585 participants in the primary analysis sample.” 以及“Of participants in the Facebook and Instagram primary analysis samples, respectively, 17,802 and 13,480 completed the endline survey. These attrition rates (10 and 13 percent)…”。另跨研究比较自述“largest sample size (31,282 compared to a prior maximum of 1,955)”。

(b) 逐字(摘要):“People who deactivated Facebook for the six weeks before the election reported a 0.060 standard deviation improvement in an index of happiness, depression, and anxiety, relative to controls who deactivated for just the first of those six weeks.” 正文:“Facebook and Instagram deactivation improved emotional state index by 0.060 standard deviations (p < 0.001) and 0.041 standard deviations (p = 0.016), respectively.” FB 多重校正后仍显著成立:“The q-values … are 0.002 and 0.139 for Facebook and Instagram”,导论并称 FB “statistically distinguishable from zero at the p < 0.01 level, both when considered individually and after adjusting for multiple hypothesis testing”。

(c) 逐字核对通过,原句为:“The effect is statistically distinguishable from zero at the p = 0.016 level when considered individually, and at the p = 0.14 level after adjusting for multiple hypothesis testing along with the outcomes in Allcott et al. (2024). The latter estimate does not meet our pre-registered p = 0.05 significance threshold.” 待验论断所引片段与原文一致(原文 “p = 0.05” 带空格)。

(d) 逐字核对通过,摘要原句:“Exploratory analysis suggests the Facebook effect is driven by people over 35, while the Instagram effect is driven by women under 25.” 非预注册属性由正文确认:“the pre-analysis plan … did not specify what subgroup analysis might be done for secondary outcomes such as emotional state … we present non-preregistered ‘exploratory’ analysis of subgroups defined by above- vs. below-median values … We present unadjusted p-values for subgroup analyses.”

(d) 子群数值:“For Facebook, the point estimates are larger for people over 35 than for younger users. The effects for 35+ vs. 18-34 are statistically different with p = 0.046. For Instagram, the estimates are largest for women aged 18-24: an improvement of 0.111 standard deviations (p = 0.002). The point estimates for all other groups are less than half as large and are statistically indistinguishable from zero. The effects on the four age-by-gender subgroups are statistically different with p = 0.062.”

(f) 逐字核对通过,对照组第 1 周停用设计成立:“The Deactivation group was told that they would receive $150 if they did not log into the focal platform for the next six weeks, while the Control group was told that they would receive $25 if they did not log in for the next week.” 设计意图:“By including a short deactivation period for the Control group, we guaranteed that the only differences between Control and Deactivation were the total payment amount and deactivation length … This reduced the risk of experimenter demand effects, differential attrition, and any spurious effects that might be artifacts of the deactivation process itself.” 时间点:账号自 9/23 起停用,对照组 9/30、实验组 11/4 自动恢复。

(g) 逐字核对通过,原句为:“Facebook’s user experience was very different during that rollout period—for example, there was no news feed—so the effects could be quite different two decades later.” 论文后段另有对应表述:“the Facebook user experience has changed significantly in the past two decades: for example, there was no news feed, and the user base was over 100 times smaller.” 并给出量化对照:Braghieri 等估计心理健康指数下降 0.085 SD,“roughly forty percent larger than our point estimate”,且其人群为大学生而非 18 岁以上成人。

利益相关性核查(不推翻结论,但须披露):本文属 U.S. 2020 Facebook and Instagram Election Study,论文自述为“a partnership between Meta researchers and unpaid independent academics”,并声明“the independent academic authors had final authority over the pre-analysis plan, data analysis, and manuscript text, and Meta could not block any results from being published”。署名中至少 8 位共同作者机构写明 Meta(Crespo-Tenorio、Dimmery、Moehler、Franco、Kiewiet de Jonge、Mason、Velasco Rivera、Wilkins);NBER 披露页另载有作者接受 Meta 研究资助、付费咨询、持有 Meta 股票等情形。实验对象抽样、账号停用与被动追踪均由 Meta 执行。

外部效度限制(论文自述,构成对任何外推的约束):“The fact that less than one percent of the people who were invited to the study completed the experiment underscores that one should be cautious in generalizing results outside our sample.” 且样本相对全体用户“has a higher proportion of users with liberal views and high civic engagement”。结论段亦列出局限:“generalizability, a time-limited intervention, individual-level deactivation, self-reported outcomes, and attrition.”

效应量语境(论文自设的对照尺):共和党人比民主党人情绪指数高 0.48 SD;van Agteren et al. (2021) meta 分析中平均心理干预改善 0.27 SD;七项既往停用实验的方差倒数加权平均效应为 0.11 SD——均大于本文估计。论文结论明言“the estimated effect sizes are smaller than benchmarks such as the effects of psychological interventions, nationwide mental health trends, and previous experimental estimates in smaller samples.”
